reasons: Only semesters 4, 6 and 7 can hold modules because sem5 is exchange and sem8 is NOC.
CS4239 is Sem1-only and must be in sem7, forcing CS3235 in sem6 and CS2105, CS2106, CS2107 in sem4; CS4231 also needs CS3230 in sem4.
CS4246 needs CS3263 because CS3243 is mutually exclusive with required CS2109S, but CS2109S, CS3263 and CS4246 need three ordered semesters and sem4 is already full.
